newsitem.title: USA: CBOT wheat surges late and fast on fund buying.
newsitem.headline: CBOT wheat surges late and fast on fund buying.

text.p: CBOT wheat futures surged in fast trading late on fund buying, traders said.
"Funds are buying and buy stops were hit," a trader said.

Traders said Prudential Securities and Rosenthal Collins were buying the market late. In early dealings Griffin Trading bought two million bushels of March and FIMAT Futures bought three million bushels of March, they said.
At 1300 CST, wheat was 1-1/2 to 9-3/4 cents per bushel higher, with March up 8-1/4 at $3.72.
